Subject: Exec Week — Ground Transport & Parking Runbook

Hi Jamie / Premier ops team, and Sarah —

We're finalizing ground transport for the Acme executive workshop the week of Oct 12–15 at our SF office. High level requirements below; please review and send a firm quote + any recommended adjustments by EOD Monday:

- Headcount: 12 participants (4 execs + 8 product/staff).
- Airport pickups: 6 arrivals total across Oct 12 evening and Oct 13 morning (SFO & OAK). We prefer black car for execs (CEO + CFO) and group sedan/SUV for others.
- Event-day shuttles: daily hotel -> office AM (08:00) and office -> hotel PM (18:30) for 3 days. Rough ETA windows will be finalized when we share flight list.
- Rental vehicles: 2 SUV rentals for product demo gear (large trunk space) onsite Oct 12–15. Drivers optional; we can self-drive if rentals include insurance options.
- CEO dinner (Oct 13, 19:00): round-trip black car for 2 (pickup from Four Seasons, 18:15; return ~22:30).
- Parking: we need 4 daily garage passes for long-term parking (staff using cars) and 2 short-term guest validations for the deliverable drop-off on Oct 12.
- Fallback plan: if black cars are unavailable, provide premium rideshare alternatives with guaranteed wait-times and surge protection.

Billing: Acme will provide PO# 98765 for transportation services; we need Premier's invoice details and whether you accept billing directly to Acme (net 30) or if Redwood should reconcile and invoice Acme. Please include accounting contact and required PO fields.

Attached: flight_et_alist.csv (ETA windows + passenger names), site_parking_map.pdf (SF office garage layout).

Thanks — we need this locked by Tue EOD to publish the internal runbook.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Programs, Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa / Sarah,

Thanks for the detailed brief. Appreciate the PDF and flight list — we've sketched a draft plan and attached a preliminary estimate (premier-estimate.pdf). Highlights:

- Exec black cars: $120/hr (minimum 3 hours per booking).
- SUV rentals: $95/day (including 200 miles/day + basic insurance).
- Airport sedan pickups: flat $65 (SFO) / $75 (OAK) per vehicle.
- Hotel <-> office shuttle (sprinter van): $225/day for two runs (AM/PM), includes driver and expedited curb access.
- Parking passes: we can reserve garage validations for $12/vehicle/day; short-term drop-off validations $8 each.

Total estimated not-to-exceed: $4,150 (based on current flight ETAs). See attached for line items. We can hold rates for 7 days.

Billing options: we accept direct invoicing to Acme Corp (send PO and billing contact) or we can bill Redwood and provide a detailed invoice for you to forward. Acme billing requires the PO number on the invoice and a remittance address; please confirm which you prefer.

A few questions to firm up scheduling:
- Confirm which two passengers are the exec black-car priority (we'll reserve the earliest SFO pickup window).
- For SUVs: do you want drivers included? Drivers would allow door-to-door handling of demo gear.
- Any special lodging pickup restrictions at the Four Seasons (valet-only curb, specific coordinates)?

If you confirm the above, we'll issue a reservation block and send the booking confirmation + pickup spreadsheet (premier-confirmation.xlsx).

Best,
Jamie Carter
Operations Lead | Premier Car Service
